entities.summary: Moulay El Hassan Stadium is a football stadium in the area of El Youssoufia, Rabat, Morocco, which has been the home of FUS Rabat since 2012. The stadium has a seating capacity of 22,000. The old stadium was renovated in 2012 and demolished in 2024.
